text:
alex: Quick sync — Datadog + OpenTelemetry integration bundle for marketplace. thinking joint dashboard + prebuilt OTEL config. timeline?
maria: Love it. Is this the same bundle we sketched with infra last quarter? :eyes:
alex: @maria similar but we need a tighter GTM and a coordinated announcement. Dedicated customers care about tracing + cost metrics.
sam: Pinged infra for the OTEL collector config. I'll drop a sample in the repo later today.
julie: Marketing: want at least 2 weeks for co-branded assets + an announcement draft. Can we commit to a publish date?
kevin: From partnerships: datadog legal needs partner MOU + marketplace listing checklist. I'll own collection of docs.
alex: Proposed timeline: collect docs by Mon (1757950000), engineering integration/QA next two weeks, partner review, then announce. Thoughts?
maria: That works. Also need a canonical dashboard spec — what panels, which spans/traces, service map. I'll sketch 6 widgets.
sam: Here's a minimal OTEL config snippet I plan to use:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
julie: Nice. Marketing ask — include screenshots of the dashboard and 3 short customer quotes (beta). Can eng provide GIF of tracing flow?
alex: integrations-bot: uploaded docs/marketplace/dog-otel-bundle-v1.md
kevin: I'll coordinate legal + send MOU template. @maria can you list the dashboard fields so I can include them in the marketplace listing?
maria: Will do. I'll post the widget list in #product tomorrow.
julie: Great — let's reconvene Thurs 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks all — next steps captured. If anyone hits a blocker DM me.
